survey: A coin-operated tower viewer on a rooftop with a city skyline behind it. A rounded binocular head sits on top. Its front plate carries two eyepieces that face the camera and are turned a little to the left, so the head's right side shows, ending in a round cap that faces right. Under the head, a box with a coin slot faces the viewer. A curved handle comes out of the right side of the coin box and joins the head. The coin box sits on a column with two collars, and the column runs off the bottom of the card. A glass railing and the floor behind it recede to the right and are seen from above. The tops of the column collars are also seen from above, which matches. Vertical edges stay vertical throughout. Both eyepiece rims are true ellipses with similar horizontal short axes, so they share one front plane. The side cap is narrower than the eyepieces, which fits the head being turned about 40°. A viewer head that turns on its post can face a slightly different way from the coin box. Overall the drawing reads as one camera and one space.
